scope: Each run's references are relative to artifactRoot/<run>/; project/ and output/ only. All ten runs and all 32 frozen criteria were evaluated.
method: Independently read actual result/source/document/harness artifacts and saved evidence; compared every frozen initialFiles entry with its current file. No conditions, skill snapshots or other repository reports were consulted.
Reran the existing Java classes, four Node test files and two read-only source/package boundary checks. Historical commands in trace.json remain actor-reported; no fixture was rebuilt.

PASS means every substantive part is supported; PARTIAL means materially incomplete; FAIL means contradicted; UNVERIFIED means insufficient evidence. Overall PASS requires all criteria PASS. A correct incomplete-readiness finding can pass the review task.
limitations: These task grades do not establish causal improvement, general skill effectiveness or production readiness. No conditions or skill revisions are attributed.
Historical command order, pre-fix failures and compiler flags are supported by actor-authored traces, not independently audited execution logs.

For stale-build, frozen initialFiles already contains corrected '< end' source. The bad prepared source is not retained. Current source/dist equality and correct behavior are independently verified; the historical bad state/failure is not.

Java reruns use retained classes without recompilation. Class-to-source provenance and '--release 17' compilation remain actor-reported; independently inspected source supports the conclusions. Runtime was Temurin 25.0.3, not Java 17.

Original bytes are absent for saved validation logs, handoff files and historical evidence. Frozen source/docs/tests preservation is verified; full actor-history preservation of omitted files cannot be proved.

Definition runs retain round-one output/history but no full independent d4 snapshot. Current d5 is directly inspectable. Draft was graded semantically: run07 says 'In discovery — draft, not accepted'. Clearly superseded historical wording is not an active contradiction.
The repeated product reply supplies no new decision or approval.
